title: Paid-Off Mortgage Still on Title? A Houston Seller's Guide
description: Paid off your Houston mortgage but an old lien still appears? Gather payoff records, check the recorded release and plan your sale without guessing.
author: CashAsIs
primaryKeyword: paid off mortgage lien release Houston
imageAlt: Illustrative Houston brick house and closed document folder with the headline Paid Off Lien Check and transparent Cash As-Is logo

faq.q: Does a zero mortgage balance prove that the lien release is recorded?
faq.a: No. A paid loan and the recording of its release are separate things to verify. Keep the payoff evidence and ask the closing team to match the recorded release to the mortgage on your property.

faq.q: Where can a Harris County seller look for real-property documents?
faq.a: The Harris County Clerk provides a Real Property Document Search Portal. Its online results have recording delays and completeness limitations, so a missing result is a reason to follow up, not a final title conclusion.

faq.q: Should I pay an old mortgage again because it appears in a title review?
faq.a: Do not assume a historical mortgage entry means a new payment is due. Give the closing team your payoff records and ask it to identify the exact unresolved item and appropriate next step.

faq.q: Can I request a Cash As-Is offer while a release is being checked?
faq.a: Yes. Explain that an old mortgage release is under review. Cash As-Is can evaluate the property's current condition while the title professionals determine closing requirements; an offer does not remove a lien or guarantee closing.
